name: Disaster Wedding
source:
A modern-day reimagining of William Shakespeare's "A Midsummer Night's Dream." You play an intern at a catering agency tasked with preparing the wedding of Annie and Demetrio. But not everything goes according to plan, and it becomes your job to ensure that the wedding goes off without a hitch.

[Translated from [url=https://escgoat-studio.itch.io/disaster-wedding-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
威廉·莎士比亚的《仲夏夜之梦》的现代重新演绎。你扮演一家餐饮公司的实习生，负责准备安妮和德梅特里奥的婚礼。但并非一切都按计划进行，确保婚礼顺利进行就成了你的工作。

[译自[url=https://escgoat-studio.itch.io/disaster-wedding-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
